description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects traversal components beneath the documented public TeamCity routing prefixes.
affected_versions: JetBrains TeamCity: 0 to <2023.11.4; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects traversal components beneath the documented public TeamCity routing prefixes.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Literal traversal-like resource paths under these prefixes are denied.
